definition: Tone deafness is a form of mental or psychic deafness in which a person can still hear sounds but cannot properly understand or appreciate their musical meaning. In this historical usage, it is grouped with musical deafness or amusia as a problem of interpreting sounds rather than a loss of hearing itself.
